_doc: Embed layout for member records (logs). Styled like /status: gold accent bar, emoji headers, structured fields. Edit any value below to change how each record looks. Text in {braces} is replaced per record. A field whose {placeholders} ALL resolve to empty is hidden when 'skip_empty_lines' is true. 'color' accepts 0xRRGGBB, #RRGGBB, or a plain number. URL values (icon_url / thumbnail / image) are dropped if any placeholder they use is empty, so you never get a broken link.

_available_placeholders.user_id: Author's numeric Discord user ID (searchable key).
_available_placeholders.author_avatar: URL of the author's avatar (for author / thumbnail icon).
_available_placeholders.in_game_name: Warframe in-game name (OCR-only; blank for role-derived refreshes).
_available_placeholders.clan: Clan name from the member's clan role.
_available_placeholders.platform: Platform (PC / Xbox / PlayStation / Switch / Mobile) from role.
_available_placeholders.mastery_rank: Mastery Rank (exact 'MR 28' / 'Legendary 3' when known, else role bucket).
_available_placeholders.syndicate: Syndicate name(s) from the member's syndicate role(s).
_available_placeholders.sent_unix: Original message timestamp (unix seconds) for <t:..> tags.
_available_placeholders.source_message_id: Original message ID in the source channel.
_available_placeholders.attachment_count: Number of attachments on the original message.
_available_placeholders.image_name: Filename of the attached screenshot, for image: attachment://{image_name}.
